exposure: Feeding duration at 1 year of age
cohort: 229 infants from the New Hampshire Birth Cohort Study
finding: Breastfeeding duration modifies the longitudinal impact of delivery mode on the taxonomic composition of the microbiota by 1 year of age.
mod_finding: Cesarean-delivered infants who were breastfed for less than 6 months had a gut microbiome more dissimilar to vaginally delivered infants than those breastfed for 6 months or longer.
